_comment: Copy to a project's .claude/dev-stack.json to enable the dev_stack_reminder hook. When you sign off (bye/goodnight/ttyl...) and a container matching container_filter is still running, you get a one-line reminder with stop_command. Absent file = hook is a silent no-op.
stop_command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.wiki-polis.yaml -f docker-compose.local.yaml down (from the particiapp-docker dir)
